reason: The README describes an agent orchestration plugin that dynamically creates, persists, hot-mounts, removes, and restores Cordis plugins, including tools, event hooks, system prompt rules, and timers that can wake the agent; its documented unsandboxed host-level execution warrants human review.

summaries.zh: 一个支持智能体动态创建、持久化、热加载和卸载工具及行为钩子的自进化编排插件。
summaries.en: An agent-orchestration plugin that dynamically creates, persists, hot-loads, and removes tools and behavioral hooks across sessions.

capabilities: Dynamically persists and loads arbitrary ESM plugin source
Hot-mounts and removes agent tools and Cordis event hooks
Registers timers that can wake the agent and initiate turns
Persists plugin state across sessions and restarts
Executes evolution code with the host harness permissions and without a sandbox
Can perform filesystem and network operations through loaded plugins
